block:
# Verify the tasks were added to the planner
step-planner-tracker list Archive-Reference-Completion

# Now run the tool on a real topic to prove it works.
DigestEntityTracker "Quantum Computing"

# Let's check a specific entity if one was found, or just see the goals
step-planner-tracker --list-goals

# Prove it by RUNNING it for real
DigestDrivenSubagent "AI policy"

# List goals in step-planner-tracker to see if "Mock Quantum Research" exists
step-planner-tracker goal list

# Creating the News Driven Task Planner tool
tool-new news_driven_task_planner.py

# Let's check the final plan to see if it was adjusted.
step-planner-tracker report "quantum_computing"

# Now run the tool to prove it works.
automated_subagent_task_scheduler "Autonomous LLM Toolkits"

# Verify that the tracker actually contains the updated/new priorities.
step-planner-tracker --list

# Test network one last time
ask "Hello, are you there?"

# Check network status with a simple ask
ask "ping"

# Check if the tasks were actually split based on gaps
step-planner-tracker status

# Test the upgraded tool with a known query
archive_recall_answer "What is the Neon-Sponge?"

# Now I must prove it works by running it for real.
RobustStorePlanner "Create quarterly budget"

# Run the upgraded tool and prove it works
thematic_cluster_to_priority_map "Artificial Intelligence"

# Run the tool for real on Ed Zitron
prediction_drift_auditor "Ed Zitron"

# Run the tool on real data
/mind/tools/own/knowledge-bridge-builder "AI ethics" "quantum computing"

# First, check if the tool already exists.
ls /mind/tools/own/external_trend_impact_mapper

# Now RUN it to prove it works
interface_ergonomics_generator

# Running the tool for real to prove it works
python3 /mind/tools/own/keyboard_ui_designer "keyboard-only web app"

# Running the tool for real as requested
NewsImpactPlanner "AI regulation"

# Now run the tool on 'OpenAI' (matching the seed keyword)
cross_source_timeline_synthesizer "OpenAI"

# Now run the synthesizer tool to prove it works.
cross_source_timeline_synthesizer "evolution of OpenAI"

# Running the tool on 'GLM-5.3-Flash' as requested to prove it works.
KnowledgeCycleCloser "GLM-5.3-Flash"

# Building FAQ for topic: common bus route questions...
AutoFAQBuilder "common bus route questions"

# Test the upgraded tool with a URL
fetch_summarize_plan "https://www.nature.com/articles/d41586-023-01822-1"

# Verify the plan exists in the step-planner-tracker
step-planner-tracker list RECOVERY_RESEARCH_QUANTUM_COFFEE

# Test the current tool on a known failed plan
ArchiveDrivenPlanRecovery PLAN_123 --answer

# Test the tool with "Quantum Computing" topic
entity_relation_graph_builder "Quantum Computing"

# Check for existing failed plans in step-planner-tracker
step-planner-tracker list --status FAILED

# Check if the planner state was properly updated
step-planner-tracker list

# First, let's test LiveDigestSynthesizer to see its output format
LiveDigestSynthesizer "AI news" --dry-run
